healthy_proxy: All samples not inside a published P-1 anomaly interval are class 0.
degraded_proxy: For an anomaly interval [a,b] inclusive, the FIRST max(1, floor((b-a+1)*0.20)) samples are class 1.
fault_proxy: The remaining samples of the same interval are class 2.
boundaries: If an anomalous interval is of length 1, it produces only class 1; non-overlapping intervals assumed.
score_proxy: No physical 0-100 health scores exist. Simulated feedback targets are defined in a separate frozen config and do not affect state labels.
prohibited: Never infer physical failure from class 2.
Never use test measurements, model scores, or test metrics to change this labeling rule.
Never treat proxy class metrics as verified fault diagnosis.
No normal-operation change labels or technician feedback exist in this dataset.
rationale: Frozen unchanged from V1 to permit architectural ablation under exactly the same artificial target; position in anomaly segment is a pedagogical proxy, not a degradation mechanism.
label_creation_time: Prior to feature engineering / MSF-MOFS V1.1 experiments.
